# Sample document

This document exercises a representative spread of link shapes.

A valid http(s) link: [Example](https://example.com/page)

A valid mailto link: [Email us](mailto:someone@example.com)

[ref]: https://example.com/reference

A link with an empty target: [empty]()

A link with an ftp target: [files](ftp://example.com/file.txt)

A link whose target has an unencoded space: [broken](https://example.com/has space)

A root-relative link: [abs](/absolute/path)

A plain relative link, which is not flagged: [rel](./relative.md)
